name: Crossing at San Felice Scalo with the interlocking
description: Valle Lauro line as a single track with two-track stations, ETCS with the reference onboard and the interlocking trackside: the controlled train runs its usual timetable towards Monte Clanio while R 2101 leaves Monte Clanio in the opposite direction. The interlocking sets the reverse routes of R 2101, gives each single-track segment to one direction at a time (block consent) and sends R 2101 onto track II of San Felice Scalo, where the two trains cross.
